query:
SELECT 
  t.nome AS tecnico,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(os.qtdApInstalado) AS total_aps
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON e.id = os.escolaId
JOIN tecnicos t ON t.id = os.tecnicoId
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
  AND e.municipio LIKE '%Ribeira do Amparo%'
GROUP BY t.nome
ORDER BY total DESC;
